name: eve-market-scout
description: Modular EVE Online market intelligence: collection, alerts, trade analysis, historical analytics.

scripts.dev:worker: npm run db:migrate:local --workspace @eve-market-scout/ingest-api && npm run dev --workspace @eve-market-scout/ingest-api -- --port 8787 --var LOCAL_DEV:true
